service.description: PLC log events over MQTT: a DrtSubscribe or DrtEvent request whose topic (DeviceRequest.query) carries the log events of the moqui-plc LoggerFacade. An event with a source is stored as a ParameterLog of that Parameter, an event without one as a DeviceLog, through InboundServices.store#PlcLog. The loggerName of each event must be the deviceId of the request. DrtUnsubscribe stops it. Set as DeviceRequest.runServiceName; called by moqui.device.DeviceServices.run#DeviceRequest. A request whose endpoint is another protocol is an error.
